entry.title: Install and update with dnf
entry.summary: Register the repository once and dnf upgrade keeps you current. Packages are signed and the repository ships with gpgcheck=1.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build4 released
entry.summary: Continuously animating pages — Canvas, CSS animation, video — no longer freeze in software mode.

entry.title: GPU rendering works with a single environment variable
entry.summary: Switch to the GPU path with BLINKGTK_GPU_MODE=egl alone. No application code changes required.

entry.title: Reported a vertical-writing line-breaking issue upstream
entry.summary: In vertical writing, a closing bracket at the line end can leave the line half filled. Reported upstream with reproduction steps and measurements.

entry.title: Updated to Chromium 151
entry.summary: Emphasis marks no longer inflate line pitch, and ruby overhang behaves as specified.
